reference_sql:
WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.ship_to_country, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.ship_to_country
)
SELECT ship_to_country, MAX(units) AS max_units
FROM order_units
GROUP BY ship_to_country
alternatives: WITH order_units AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.ship_to_country, MAX(u.units) AS max_units FROM order_units u JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = u.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_to_country

WITH order_units AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.ship_to_country, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ship_to_country, MAX(units) AS max_units FROM order_units GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: WITH order_units AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.ship_to_country, MAX(u.units) AS max_units FROM order_units u JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = u.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_to_country
other_way.tradeoff: Adding up the lines before the join keeps the step on one table, but the country then needs a join in the final query.
